How long have you been experiencing these difficulties with your attention? Did they start recently, or have they been present since you were a child?

It has been really noticeable and difficult for about a year and ten months now, almost two years. However, these attention problems actually first started back when I was a kid, definitely before I turned 12.
Alongside these attention struggles, do you often feel restless, have trouble sitting still, or find yourself acting or speaking impulsively?

Yes, I struggle with that a lot. I'm constantly fidgeting, tapping my hands or feet, and squirming whenever I try to sit still. I also have a really hard time staying in my seat and often find myself getting up, even when I'm expected to remain seated.
Over the past year and ten months, have you also been dealing with persistent, excessive worry about everyday things, or have you been feeling down and losing interest in your usual activities?
No, I haven't really been dealing with excessive worry or feeling down and losing interest in things. My main struggles are definitely just with my focus and that constant feeling of restlessness.
Besides having trouble listening, do you also struggle with organizing tasks, frequently losing things, or being easily distracted?
No, I don't really struggle with organizing my tasks or losing my things. I also wouldn't say I'm easily distracted; it's just more about my mind drifting off when people are talking directly to me.
Do you often find yourself talking excessively, blurting out answers before a question is finished, or interrupting others when they are speaking?
No, I don't really have those issues. I don't think I talk excessively, and I don't usually blurt out answers or interrupt others when they are speaking.
